content.user_title: Edit Videos with RunComfy Model Routing
content.value_statement: Video edits often fail when the wrong model handles the job. This skill routes each request to a RunComfy model with matching prompts and limits.
actual_capabilities: Classifies video edit requests by intent before selecting a RunComfy model.
Routes general restyle, background swap, and packaging edits to Wan 2.7 Edit-Video.
Routes reference motion transfer tasks to Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control.
Routes lightweight identity-stable restyle and outfit changes to Lucy Edit Restyle.
Provides model field requirements, prompting tips, limitations, and CLI invocation guidance.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, and valid media URLs.
Uses a remote model service, so prompts and media URLs are sent outside the local machine.
Selects one model per request and does not blend multiple routes.
Cannot exceed each model limit for duration, resolution, aspect ratio, or input format.

use_cases.title: Restyle Talking-Head Clips
use_cases.description: Change background, lighting, or overall style while preserving face, pose, lip movement, and audio when supported.

use_cases.title: Transfer Reference Motion
use_cases.description: Map motion from a reference clip onto a target character with a route built for temporal consistency.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Variant Videos
use_cases.description: Use reference imagery to replace packaging or visual details while retaining camera motion and framing.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Restyle
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short clip with one visual change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this video with RunComfy. Preserve the subject face and motion, then change the background to a clean studio setting: [video URL].

prompt_templates.title: Outfit Swap
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a localized identity-stable change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the best RunComfy route to change the outfit to professional business attire. Preserve identity, pose, and motion: [video URL].

prompt_templates.title: Reference Motion Transfer
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using a target character and motion reference.
prompt_templates.prompt: Transfer the motion from this reference clip to the target character. Keep character identity stable and preserve the reference audio if supported.

prompt_templates.title: Packaging Replacement
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with a source clip and visual reference.
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace the visible package design using this reference image. Maintain original framing, hand movement, camera motion, and source audio where supported.

output_examples.input: A user asks to restyle a ten second speaker clip with a modern office background.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Wan 2.7 Edit-Video and prioritizes face, pose, lip movement, and source audio preservation.

output_examples.input: A user provides a target character image and a dance reference video.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control and frames the task as motion transfer instead of general restyle.

output_examples.input: A user wants only a clothing change on an identity-sensitive portrait clip.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Lucy Edit Restyle and keeps the prompt focused on outfit change, face preservation, and motion preservation.

best_practices: State preservation goals first, then describe one edit direction.
Choose reference images only when the edit needs direct visual transfer.
Check model duration, resolution, and audio limits before running the CLI.
anti_patterns: Combining many visual changes in one run, which can reduce temporal consistency.
Using motion control for simple restyle tasks that do not need reference motion.
Passing private or sensitive media URLs without confirming RunComfy processing requirements.

faq.question: What does this skill edit?
faq.answer: It edits existing videos through RunComfy models for restyle, background swap, packaging change, outfit swap, and motion transfer tasks.

faq.question: Does it generate video locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the local RunComfy CLI to send requests to RunComfy model services.

faq.question: Which model is the default route?
faq.answer: Wan 2.7 Edit-Video is the default for broad restyle, background, packaging, and commercial polish requests.

faq.question: When should I use Kling Motion Control?
faq.answer: Use it when the main goal is transferring motion from a reference video to a target character.

faq.question: When should I use Lucy Edit Restyle?
faq.answer: Use it for lighter localized restyles, such as outfit changes or lighting changes, where identity stability matters.

faq.question: What inputs should users prepare?
faq.answer: Prepare valid media URLs, a clear edit instruction, and any justified reference image or motion video.
